notes: Curated core of the Phoenix web framework: Phoenix itself, Router (+ Scope, Route), Endpoint (+ Supervisor, RenderErrors), Controller (+ Pipeline), Channel, Socket (+ Transport, Message), Presence, VerifiedRoutes, Token, Logger, Config, Param, Naming, Flash, URL, Exceptions, CodeReloader, Debug. Left out for the ~400k budget: the Mix generators (lib/mix/tasks/phx.gen.*, incl. phx.gen.auth), test helpers (test/conn_test, test/channel_test), transports (websocket/long_poll), digester, code_reloader submodules, router helpers/console formatter, and endpoint cowboy adapter and watcher. The official guides are in phoenix_guides.txt. Files joined with '--- SOURCE: <repo path> ---' separators, code unmodified.
